category: inference gateway, keyed; model listing is keyless

free_tier.stated: Every account can spend $3 per day across all endpoints and make 7,500 requests per 30 minutes; no credit card
free_tier.notes: the model catalogue is OpenRouter's; GET /proxy/v1/models answers 200 with no key while the chat call answers 401 without one

tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client with an sk-hc-v1 key created on the dashboard (up to 50 active keys)
chaining: no keyless chain: the chat route needs a key issued to a signed-in Hack Club account

limits.value: 7,500 requests per 30 minutes per user, shared across all endpoints; 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header
USD 3 per day of spend per account across all endpoints, resets at 00:00 UTC; 402 Payment Required when reached

binding_note: the USD 3 per day spending cap binds for large models; the 7,500 per 30 minutes request ceiling is far above it

identity_cost.detail: sign in with a Hack Club account, then create an API key; the rules page states the service is for teens 18 and under only, and lists a 403 for an account that needs identity verification

reliability_note: a keyless chat call answers 401 Authentication required while the keyless listing answers 200, so a listing check alone mistakes it for an open endpoint
confidence_note: identity and limits are first-party; the 401 on a keyless chat call is from a third-party prober, and the keyless listing was read by GET. No completion was sent
